author: Shivamlol
quote:
**** game, If I wanted realism so much, my favourite game would be google maps, dude, lol.

pretty much just grand theft redemption 3. the ideas are taken straight out of rdr2, like with chapters, the house building, the monotonous tasks that make you wonder if you're really playing a gta game, the honor system, collectables, explorables and even animations. how do you spend 2 billion dollars and 13 years on developing a game, only for it to be nothing like the predecessors? red dead redemption 2 is a great game, because its trying to be itself. now you have rdr3 disguised as a gta game. 

GTA is about rise or fall in the crime world, not sympathy or retarfed empathy to **** criminals, who chose to ruin innocent's lives, and themselves too, They are not some poor guys who did not chose to be poor, But they are criminal because they choose they want to gain on the corpses of others, They are greedy, Prideful, and sinful, There is no real love in their life, only senseless and mindless paranoia, Love? What are the reated people at r* talking about?

Arthur Morgan was born in country where laws means little, It was semi anarchic, It was unstable Miniarchy, The entire point of RDR2’s story is that the Wild West era was over, civilization and Pinkerton law enforcement had arrived, and Dutch’s gang kept robbing and murdering out of pride, delusion, and refusal to adapt to normal society, Arthur Morgan was born and raised inside an outlaw cult on a fading frontier; he knew no other life, and the tragic tension of RDR2 comes from a man realizing his entire worldview is obsolete, thats why he had to step in, even then he didn't wanted to, He was doing the nesscessary even then, but what the **** jason and lucia? Who don't particularly have any reason, and can literally get a minimum wage job rn.

 Crimes are a deliberate shortcut for fast money, thrill, or status rather than survival.

Rise-and-Fall Ruthlessness (Vice City, San Andreas, GTA IV & V): In the older entries, the protagonists weren't framed as tragic victims, they were ruthless, selfish, or deeply flawed criminals climbing a ladder of greed, betrayal, and paranoia. Even in GTA IV, the darkest entry, Niko Bellic’s pursuit of the American Dream ended in isolation and loss rather than romantic redemption.

With Jason and Lucia, Rockstar leaned into a Bonnie-and-Clyde style crime-drama template, treating their bond, trust, and personal redemption as the emotional anchor rather than cynical satire or pure criminal ambition.

Thats why the game tries to be rdr3, but is ****, It's not even Gta. Literally worst of all worlds, Lol.
